correctness.rationale: Necessity follows from counting interior coordinates among the summands. Sufficiency follows from assigning <=mk non-grid coordinates to m summands with capacity k and using one-variable tiled intervals. Nearest-grid rounding is optimal for each coordinate norm and cell midpoints attain the maximum. The uniform grid is a contractible cubical CW ball, its t-skeleton is (t-1)-connected, and Euler characteristic gives the stated wedge multiplicity. The packaged checker passes 23 exact sumset cases, 23 mod-two homology-rank cases and six rational metric checks, all supplementary.
